s: Seder seuda hammapseqet ubo y' seipim: mitzvat aseh min hattora lehosip min hachol al haqqodesh, ben beinnuy ben beissur melaka, shenneemar "veinnitem et napshotekem betisha lachodesh baereb meereb ad ereb tishbetu shabbattekem", yakol yitanneh batteshii lachodesh? Talmud lomar "baereb", i baereb yakol mishshettechshak? Talmud lomar "betisha", ha ketzad? Matchil umitanneh mibbeod yom, mikkan shemmosipim mechol al haqqodesh. (Veap al pi shemmimmiqra zeh lamadnu besiman tr"d shemmitzva leekol beereb yom kippur, mikkol maqom peshat hakkatub mishshum taanit mammash kemo shennitbaer kan, ella shemmitzvat chakamim hi leharbot bisuda beereb yom kippur mittaam shennitbaer sham, umatzeu lahem semek min hattora, shenneemar "veinnitem vego' betisha lachodesh", upereshu bo chakamim sheyyakin et atzmo baakilat teshii leinnuy shel asiri). En li ella millepanayv, milleacharayv minnayin? Talmud lomar "meereb ad ereb", huqqeshu shene haarabim zeh lazeh, veen li ella yom hakkippurim, shabbat minnayin? Talmud lomar "tishbetu", yom tob minnayin? Talmud lomar "shabbattekem", kol shebut sheatta shobet — atta mosip lah ben millepaneha ben milleachareha. Yakol yehe anush karet al hattosepet? Talmud lomar "vekol hannepesh asher taaseh kol melaka beetzem hayyom hazzeh vehaabadti vego'", veken beinnuy hu omer "ki kol hannepesh asher lo teunneh beetzem hayyom hazzeh venikreta vego'" — al itztzumo shel yom anush karet, abal en onesh karet al hattosepet:

Vetosepet zeh tzarik sheyyehe qodem ben hashshemashot, deillu ben hashshemashot atzmo (sepeq yom) sepeq layla hu veeno niqra tosepet, veap im lo haya hakkatub mazhir alayv — haya tzarik liprosh missepeq abera:

Vetosepet zeh en lo shiur, ella shemmittechillat hashsheqia sheen hashshemesh nireh al haaretz ad ben hashshemashot shehu g' rebie milin qodem hallayla, vehazzeman hazzeh shehu mahalak g' milin urebia ratza laasot kullo tosepet — oseh, ratza laasot miqtzatah — oseh, ubilbad sheyyosip ezeh zeman sheyyihyeh vadday mechol al haqqodesh:

Nashim sheokelot veshotot ad ben hashshemashot mammash vehen enan yodeot shemmitzva lehosip mechol al haqqodesh — en memachin beyadan, im hu yadua shebbevadday lo yishmeu lanu veyaasu bezadon, demutab sheyyihyu shogegin veal yihyu mezidim. Veken haddin bekol debar issur sheeno meporash battora ella shechakamim lemaduhu mimmidrash happesuqim, o shehu qabbala beyadam halaka lemosheh missinay, o shehen beatzman aseru dabar veadam echad ober al dibrehem bishgaga sheeno yodea haissur, veap im yodia lo haissur lo yeqabbel mimmennu — eno tzarik limchot beyado, demutab sheyyihyeh shogeg velo yihyeh mezid:

Abal dabar sheissuro meporash battora, ap al pi sheyyadua lanu shehachote hazzeh lo yeqabbel mimmennu ap im nodia lo haissur — ap al pi ken tzarik limchot beyado, lepi shekkol yisrael arebin zeh bazeh veal yede shemmocheh beyado hu motzi et atzmo mehaarbut. Umikkol maqom, lo yokichennu barabbim ella paam achat, abal lo yarbeh betokachot barabbim, meachar shebbarur lo shello yeqabbel mimmennu, veal zeh ameru "keshem shemmitzva lomar dabar hannishma kak mitzva shello lomar dabar sheeno nishma". Abal chayyab lehokicho beyachid apillu mea peamim ad sheyyinzop bo hachote, shekkevan shehodia lo haissur vehu ober alayv bezadon — chayyab kol echad veechad miyyisrael lehokicho, shenneemar "hokeach tokiach" — apillu mea peamim. Mikkol maqom, im hi abera shebbasseter — yokichennu bitchilla basseter, veim lo shab middarko — maklimim oto barabbim ad sheyyashub, abal im ober abera begaluy — mokichin oto miyyad, shello yitchallel shem shamayim:
Mi shehokiach et chabero venazap bo chabero hachote — lo yokichennu od al abera zo, shenneemar "al tokach letz vego'":

Im hipsiq meakilato beod hayyom gadol, ap al pi shehiskim bedato shello leekol od hayyom — ap al pi ken muttar lo lachazor veleekol, kevan shello hotzi ken bispatayv, didbarim shebballeb enan debarim. Veim hotzi ken bispatayv — asur lo leekol middin neder (velo mechamat issur yom hakkippurim), kevan sheamar beperush shello yokal od hayyom. Abal im qibbel alayv taanit shel yom hakkippurim bistam velo amar beperush shello yokal od, im hu adayin qodem pelag hammincha — en qabbalato kelum umuttar lachazor veleekol, veim (ayyen siman rs"a taam al zeh) hu achar pelag hammincha — azay moelet qabbalato vechal alayv kol chomer shel yom hakkippurim veasur bimlaka ubirchitza vesika, chutz minneilat hassandal kemo shennitbaer besiman tqn"g, vesham nitbaer detob lehachamir ulehatnot basseuda hammapseqet sheyyehe rashshay leekol velishtot od achar hasseuda:

Beereb yom kippur apillu bisudat shacharit — en leekol ella maakalim qallim lehitakkel (kede shello yihyeh sabea) kegon besar opot vedagim, kede shello yehe sabea umitgaeh kesheyyitpallel beyom hakkippurim. Veken en okelim debarim hammarbim zera apillu bisudat shacharit, kegon shumim ubetzim, abal maakle chalab vechema ap al pi shehen marbin zera — mikkol maqom nohagin leoklam beshacharit, kevan shehem maakalim qallim lehitakkel. Abal basseuda hammapseqet shehu samuk lallayla — en leekol otam. Veken en leekol basseuda hammapseqet debarim hamchammemim et haggup [kegon] besamim vekarkom, shemma yabo lide qeri ballayla:
Im akal harbeh beereb yom kippur — lo yasim etzbao bepiv lehaqi, shemma yibla min haqqia:
Lo yokal shumshemin beereb yom kippur, mippene shemmaaleh gera beyom hakkippurim:
